baselineIdentity.adoptionNote: The baseline is adopted only by a completed Bootstrap Apply. Until then no consumer bundle, lock or verifier exists in this repository and no conformance claim is made.

executionIdentity.governingContract: Universal Project Bootstrap ADR-002 and ADR-006.
executionIdentity.approvedIdentity: The OS account the owner approved for Bootstrap Apply, Reconcile and Receipt on this target is named in the managerial work unit ENT-197. This repository is public, so the machine and account name are not repeated here.
executionIdentity.observationMethod: On this Windows target the executing identity is the account that owns the running process, read from the process access token through the platform identity interface (System.Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity.GetCurrent, properties Name and User). It is cross-checked with the platform whoami command, run with the /user option from the system directory that the operating system reports. Neither reading uses an environment variable, a Git or hosting-platform account, repository ownership, a caller-supplied string or a Bootstrap preparation field.
executionIdentity.comparison: The account name read from the token must equal the approved identity as an exact string. The whoami reading must name the same account, compared without regard to letter case because Windows account names are case-insensitive, and its security identifier must equal the security identifier read from the token exactly. Any difference blocks the Gate.
executionIdentity.gateRequirement: Before Bootstrap Apply, Reconcile or Receipt is run for this target, the applicable Gate records a fresh observation by this method and the comparison result. The observation is retained with the Bootstrap evidence outside this repository.
executionIdentity.limits: This is an assumption-and-evidence boundary. It provides no cross-user exclusion and adds nothing to the Bootstrap runtime.

mutationBoundary.status: PENDING at record time. Owner-authorized in ENT-197; not yet created.
mutationBoundary.requirement: Mutation of a real governed target requires a verified external mutation boundary for that target. A boundary established for another repository grants no authority here.
mutationBoundary.mechanism: One native repository ruleset on amir42com/readela targeting only refs/heads/main.
mutationBoundary.verification: The created ruleset is read back and compared field by field, and the effective rules for main are read. The Gate requires no bypass actor and a current-user bypass value of never.

statusCheckAddition.when: After the governance workflow published by Bootstrap has completed a successful push-event run on the focused branch in this repository.
statusCheckAddition.rule: A required_status_checks rule with the strict policy enabled, naming the observed check context and the integration that produced it.
statusCheckAddition.identityNote: The expected context is verify. The context and the integration identity are read from the real check run and are not assumed; a different observed context stops the change.

knownLimits: A repository administrator can change or delete a repository ruleset; the boundary constrains reference updates, not administration.

exactPackageBoundary.earlierPackage: The preparation the owner approved is bound to baseCommit. The commit that adds this record changes HEAD, so that preparation is no longer usable and its approval does not transfer.
exactPackageBoundary.requirement: Inspect, Plan and Prepare are run again against the commit that contains this record. Bootstrap Apply requires owner approval of that exact frozen final Plan, target identity, operation set and candidate identities, including the .gitattributes candidate.
exactPackageBoundary.recording: A preparation's identities depend on the commit that contains this file, so they cannot be written here. They are recorded in the managerial system (ENT-197) and the package is held outside the repository.
